item.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.

item.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

item.title: Heat pump tech is 170 years old. Pascal thinks it’s time for an update.
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Refrigerants startup Pascal has a new take on heat pump and cooling tech using a sponge-like material that promises to be 20% more efficient.

item.title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

item.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Elon Musk likes the idea but says he is not on either committee, which is made up of independent directors.

item.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

item.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

item.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz, Kirsten Korosec
item.description: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

item.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

item.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.

item.title: GM to close Detroit battery-assembly plant, but not for reasons you might think
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: GM is shuttering the Brownstown Battery Assembly Plant, though the closure has nothing to do with the automaker's electrification strategy.

item.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

item.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

item.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

item.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

item.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.

item.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

item.title: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, but executives reportedly failed to act
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Court documents show TikTok employees were frustrated with how executives responded to their concerns about risks to children.
